decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute. The charge TXN-008024 for 22.50 EUR (2250 cents) at Harbour Brasserie is on card CRD-000030. It was posted on 2026-08-18, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-23. That is 66 days later, within the 120-day time limit. The authorisation AUTH-008221 was approved for 18.91 EUR (1891 cents). The merchant is listed as a restaurant. No receipt is attached; the 18.91 EUR bill comes only from the cardholder's statement. The posted amount is 359 cents higher than the authorised amount. 20% of the authorised amount is 378.2 cents, so the difference is within the 20% tip allowance in the restaurant tips policy. Under that policy, the 3.59 EUR is treated as an agreed tip, not an amount mismatch.

proposed_actions.reason: Restaurants may add a tip of up to 20% of the authorised amount. Your charge was 3.59 EUR above the authorised amount of 18.91 EUR, which is within the 3.78 EUR allowed. There is no receipt showing a different agreed amount, so the extra 3.59 EUR counts as a tip.
